text:
Ravi: quick sync — onboarding sampleapp QA found duplicates when hitting 429s. different from the earlier token-rotate thread: these are webhooks that mutate downstream state. want consensus on defaults.
Ava: onboarding webhook flow = POST /v1/action -> sometimes 429 from a rate-limited route. SDK retries and we end up with double side-effects.
Lina: are we sure it's not a server-side idempotency miss? we have server support for Idempotency-Key but clients weren't setting it.
Ravi: verified in logs: client retries had no Idempotency-Key header. sampleapp used default sdk call without any header.
Ava: for webhooks it's risky to force a default header (could mask user intent) but also risky to do nothing.
Lina: proposal: SDK should attach an auto-generated Idempotency-Key for mutating routes by default, but allow opt-out via config flag (e.g., retry: { idempotency: "auto|none|preserve" }).
Ravi: nice granularity. what about streaming/long polls? we should not add keys there.
Ava: agree — only for simple POST/PUT RPCs (non-streaming, content-length small). add check in SDK: if request has Transfer-Encoding: chunked or is a streaming response stream, skip auto-key.
Lina: backoff strategy: current default is fixed-exponential w/o jitter. that causes synchronized retries during bursts. recommend full-jitter default and a capped cap.
Ravi: propose defaults: maxRetries=3, base=150ms, cap=1.5s, strategy=full-jitter. documentable and tunable.
Ava: +1. also add a per-endpoint override in the client config so users can tune for high-throughput endpoints.
Lina: metrics to add: duplicate_side_effect_count, idempotency_key_generated_count, retry_backoff_distribution. Also emit a tag when a retry used an auto-generated key vs user-supplied.
Ravi: good telemetry. ops wants alerting on duplicate_side_effect_count/5m > threshold.
Ava: security question: do we leak any PII in auto-generated idempotency keys? keep them random UUIDv4 with no payload.
Lina: use RFC4122 v4, store only hash in logs if we need to index. avoid full key in long-term logs.
Ravi: testing plan: unit tests for Node + Python to assert Idempotency-Key is present for mutating non-stream RPCs and preserved across auth refresh. integration: sampleapp harness with flaky 429 generator + synthetic downstream to assert exactly-one semantics.
Ava: implement small SDK util snippet for Node:
```js
// pseudo
const id = opts.headers['Idempotency-Key'] || generateUuid();
if (!opts.headers['Idempotency-Key'] && config.retry.idempotency === 'auto') {
  opts.headers['Idempotency-Key'] = id;
}
await sendWithRetries(req, { backoff: fullJitter, maxRetries: 3 });
```
Lina: and Python equivalent in README. parity required.
Ravi: runtime note: keep idempotency header stable across in-flight retries and token refresh events. i.e., refresh flow must re-submit same header.
Ava: deployment: schedule a canary run of updated sampleapp for 48h against staging and a quick smoke in prod next week. ops-bot: created job `canary/onboarding-idempotency-48h`.
ops-bot: scheduled: canary/onboarding-idempotency-48h (staging) :white_check_mark:
Lina: ownership: I9ll take Python & metrics export.
Ava: I9ll do Node implementation + CI test harness.
Ravi: I9ll update onboarding docs and the sampleapp to highlight the new default and opt-out knob. add CHANGELOG entry.
Lina: one more thought: expose backoff function hook so advanced users can pass a deterministic seeded jitter in tests.
Ava: good for deterministic CI. will add `backoffFactory(seed?)` optional param.
Ravi: timeline? Ava/Node PR mid-week, Lina/Python next week, canary starts Friday.
Lina: sounds good. thx folks :thumbsup:
